input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The only most-favoured-nation style provision in the Agreement runs in our favour: in § 6 (Documentation and Disputes, p0047) TrueLink undertakes that Hosting Services costs will not increase for one year and that the rates it charges us will not exceed those charged to any other party. That is a Vendor-granted MFN benefiting Mortgage Logic.com and should be preserved, not redlined. Nothing in § 5 (Compensation), § 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client) or the general provisions obliges Client to extend best pricing or terms to TrueLink or to match third-party offers — targeted searches for "favor"/"favour", "most", "best", "lowest", "no less", "third part", "rates" and "charge" return no Client-side MFN, and Exhibits A and B contain only charges payable by Client. The preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer) is therefore met, so no change is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
